items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I brought his respect up for Eric Doffey more, I know I did.

ctx.x: That's when you take a theme and develop it. He's not trying to play like Charlie Parker, a different note, a different __________ every time. I brought his respect up for Eric Doffey more, I know I did.
Yeah. It's funny that even Paul wouldn't have known.
